meta.protocol: fights dated 2026-01-01+ dropped at load; selection by forward-chained CV 2021-2023 (fit 2019..Y-1); 2024-2025 scored once (fit 2019-2023); production refit 2019-2025 by the same procedure (deployment, never scored)

selection_rule: per stat, start from nb_base (the verified mlrates + embedding mean with one NB shape); walk the ladder nb_t -> best nb_glm (ridge 30/300/3000/10000/30000) -> nb_gbm, and for sparse stats also the zero-inflated versions (and for control the zero-inflated Beta); a candidate replaces the current choice only if its pooled 2021-2023 CV log score (NLL per fight-side) is lower by more than 0.001 nats AND it is lower in at least 2 of the 3 CV years. 'JS-evaluable' excludes nb_gbm (the page has no tree evaluator for it).

meta.years: 2021-2023; NOTE engine v4 params (selfcal-pre2024) were tuned on 2019-2023, so its levels are in-sample here; 2024-2025 (final) is the clean comparison

gate.rule: ml2's rule: the statlines expert enters a stack only if the forward-chained 2021-2023 stack CV log loss (fit on 2019..Y-1, recency half-life chosen from {none, 3, 1.5} with the same 0.0005 penalty) improves by more than SEL_MIN = 0.0005
